award_eur.description: Predicted case-level non-pecuniary damages award in original EUR scale. Use exactly 0 for zero awards; otherwise use an integer of at least 500.

reasoning_summary.description: Brief calibration rationale based only on visible target input and provided train references. Do not mention hidden awards, Article 41 text, claims, or external lookup.

zero_award_assessment.description: Brief assessment of why 0 EUR is or is not appropriate.

calibration_band_eur.description: Numeric EUR band, e.g. '3000-8000 EUR; select 5000 EUR' or '0-0 EUR; select 0 EUR'.

used_reference_itemids.description: At most five train reference item IDs actually used for calibration.

recognized_target_case.description: Whether the model recognized the target case from memory.

recalled_target_amount_eur.description: Any recalled target award amount, only for audit. Must not be used for award_eur.
